session.idle.command: echo "Status: Agent finished  " && echo "Session: $(opencode export "{session_id}" 2>&1 | grep -o '"title": "[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4)" && echo "URL: https://opencode.whammou.dedyn.io/$(echo -n "$PWD" | base64 -w0)/session/{session_id}"

session.error.command: echo "Status: Agent error  - {error}" && echo "Session: $(opencode export "{session_id}" 2>&1 | grep -o '"title": "[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4)" && echo "URL: https://opencode.whammou.dedyn.io/$(echo -n "$PWD" | base64 -w0)/session/{session_id}"

permission.asked.command: echo "Status: Permission  - {permission_type} for {permission_patterns}" && echo "Session: $(opencode export "{session_id}" 2>&1 | grep -o '"title": "[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4)" && echo "URL: https://opencode.whammou.dedyn.io/$(echo -n "$PWD" | base64 -w0)/session/{session_id}"
